evaluation_methodology: in-sample fit (no held-out split -- sample too small)
small_sample_warning: Only 10 regions available (minimum 15 for a held-out split). Metrics are IN-SAMPLE (model trained and evaluated on the same rows) and must not be read as out-of-sample accuracy. A production forecaster needs many more regions and/or historical periods.
limitations: Prototype model: linear relationship between a short weather window and annual export value; not a validated production forecaster.
Export figures are a single annual cross-section (2011 USDA dataset); there is no multi-year history, so the model cannot demonstrate temporal forecast skill.
In-sample metrics (where reported) do not estimate out-of-sample performance.
